# Third-party software

This prototype references the `PicoGK` 2.2.0 NuGet package from LEAP 71.
PicoGK is distributed under the Apache License 2.0. The package and its license
remain available from <https://github.com/leap71/PicoGK>.

The generated landing-leg geometry and Annihilation Industries model source in
this directory are project artifacts, not LEAP 71 or Noyron outputs.
